reads.how: Inspected 27 installed native preset documents. Captured initialized VST3 component state and byte-identical host roundtrip.

writes.how: Kumi Rust codec changed inputParams/@p4 to 3.0, encoded VST3 component state, and reloaded it through the installed Windows x64 plugin public VST3 API. The requested value was present in plugin-reserialized state and a subsequent host roundtrip was byte-identical. Native preset and component XML share one document; no factory preset collection is embedded.
